title: Locally computable error estimators for conforming approximations of interface problems cannot be robust
summary: We prove an impossibility result for finite-range locally computable a posteriori error estimators for the conforming finite element discretization of an elliptic interface problem. For a class of interface problems with a checkerboard cross-point and $\{1,M\}$-valued coefficients, we construct two problem instances on the same interface-fitted mesh. The two instances share a piecewise-constant load for which the finite element solution and the data oscillation both vanish.
